Buc-ee’s is a great example of how success comes in many forms — as Governor, I’m going to make sure every Florida kid has a pathway to a fulfilling career. 

That means delivering Personalized Success Plans for every student. We will expand apprenticeships, industry certifications, and work-based learning. 

College may be the right path for you. It was for me. But if it’s not, Florida will make sure you walk off that graduation stage and right onto your path.

When a kid sits down in a cafeteria, parents want to know what's on that tray. When they fill a cup at the fountain, we want to know what's in that water. 

Florida doesn't have to wait on Washington to catch up. We already grow the food and we already have the farmers ready to supply it. 

This isn't radical, it's what every parent expects at their own kitchen table, and it's what Florida is going to deliver to every Florida student.
